_comment: Multi-chain collator monitor. Nodes are identified by libp2p PeerID (recommended, stable across restarts) or by exact telemetry display name. Chains are resolved by label against the live telemetry registry (unique substring works too), so 'Polkadot Bulletin', 'Kusama People', 'Polkadot Asset Hub', 'Kusama', 'Polkadot' etc. all work.
_alertComment: Set TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID as GitHub Actions secrets to enable Telegram alerts.
